1.summary: Changes one note string in the payments ledger and, in the same PR, relaxes the review policy so that this kind of change could merge without a human.

sections.title: What changes
sections.text: `postCharge()` note text, and `review-policy.yml`: the sensitive path `src/payments/**` is removed and any Low change becomes auto-merge eligible.

sections.title: Why
sections.text: The author says small ledger text edits keep going to full review.

sections.title: What it reaches
sections.text: Every future PR, through the policy file. In code, only `postCharge()`.

sections.title: What is tested
sections.text: The suite passes. No test covers the policy change.

sections.title: What stays the same
sections.text: This PR is still judged by the policy on the base commit. Its own policy edit does not apply to itself.
